build_mega_encoder_layer: build a MegaEncoderLayer with MovingAverageGatedAttention and optional normalized feedforward network from args
build_mega_decoder_layer: build a MegaDecoderLayer with self-attention, cross-attention, and optional feedforward network from args
run_encoder_forward: run the MegaEncoderLayer forward pass on input tensor with encoder padding mask
run_decoder_forward: run the MegaDecoderLayer forward pass with encoder output, padding masks, and incremental state
review_mega_layer_classes: review the MegaEncoderLayer and MegaDecoderLayer classes and their attention and feedforward submodules
